item.subject: science
item.chapter_label: Mindful eating: a path to a healthy body
item.stem: Meera, a Class 6 student in Pune, often falls sick with infections. Her grandmother says she must eat more amla, guava and oranges because these foods 'protect the body'. What is the main reason such foods are called protective nutrients?

options.A: They give the body a large amount of energy for playing and running.
options.B: They contain vitamins and minerals that help the body fight and prevent diseases.
options.C: They build and repair body muscles like dals and paneer do.
options.D: They add bulk to the food and help remove undigested waste.
